points.description: States that a function signature includes the name of the function (the function identifier).

States that a function signature includes the parameters' types (the number/types of the parameters, i.e. the parameter list). Equivalent wording such as 'parameter list' or 'argument types' is acceptable. Naming parameters without any mention of their types or list earns part marks only.

levels.says: Mentions parameters/arguments (e.g. number or names of parameters) but does not mention their types.

rubric.notes: Full marks: function name and parameter types (parameter list). Award 2.5 for each element. Mentioning the return type as an extra is not penalised, but it does not replace either required element.
